notes: en is the caption text. {shown|spoken} shows the first part on screen and sends the second to TTS; *word* is a highlighted keyword. zh is the subtitle line under it.

lines.en: This coin pays you {+5%|five percent} per flip, *on average*.
lines.zh: 這枚硬幣，每丟一次平均讓你賺 5%。

lines.en: Bet everything on it, every time,
and it will almost certainly *wipe you out*.
lines.zh: 你幾乎一定會輸到歸零。

lines.en: So who is the average *lying* to?
Nobody. It's just not about *you*.
lines.zh: 誰都沒騙。它說的根本不是你。

lines.en: It's about a *thousand* parallel yous, added together.
lines.zh: 而是一千個平行宇宙的你，加起來。

lines.en: You start with {$100|a hundred dollars}.
Heads: {+50%|plus fifty percent}. Tails: {−40%|minus forty}.
Win once: {150|one-fifty}. Lose once: *{90|ninety}*.
One win, one loss, and you're *down* {10%|ten percent}.
After a {40%|forty percent} drop, you need *{67%|sixty-seven percent}* just to get back.
lines.zh: 跌掉 40% 之後，要漲 67% 才回得來。

lines.en: The coin only gives you {50|fifty}.
So the average gains {5%|five percent} a flip.
*You* lose five.
Now let {1,000|a thousand} of you flip {100|a hundred} times.
lines.zh: 現在讓一千個你，各丟 100 次。

lines.en: The average shoots past *{$10,000|ten thousand dollars}*.
But the person in the middle has *{52¢|fifty-two cents}*.
lines.zh: 但正中間的那個人，只剩 5 毛錢。

lines.en: So where did the money go? To *this* one.
lines.zh: 錢去哪了？在這一個人身上。

lines.en: *{$7.5 million|Seven and a half million}*.
{73%|Seventy-three percent} of all the money.
Everyone's average is the *ensemble average*.
lines.zh: 所有人的平均，叫「集合平均」。

lines.en: Your one path is the *time average*.
lines.zh: 你一個人走下去的路，叫「時間平均」。

lines.en: When they match, a game is *ergodic*. This one isn't.
lines.zh: 兩者相等叫「遍歷」。這個遊戲不是。

lines.en: And you only live in *one* universe.
lines.zh: 而你，只活在其中一個宇宙。

lines.en: So the fix isn't to play less. It's to *bet less*.
Bet it all: you shrink {5%|five percent} a flip.
Bet half: you go *nowhere*.
Bet a quarter: the curve *peaks*.
lines.zh: 押四分之一：曲線來到最高點。

lines.en: That's the *Kelly criterion*.
Same thousand people, same flips, betting a quarter.
lines.zh: 同樣一千個人、同樣的正反面，只押 25%。

lines.en: The middle person now has *{$186|a hundred and eighty-six dollars}*.
lines.zh: 正中間的人，現在有 186 元。

lines.en: Seven in ten finish *ahead*.
The average? Just {$364|three sixty-four}.
Kelly makes the average look *worse*, and makes *you* richer.
lines.zh: 凱利讓平均變難看，卻讓你變有錢。

lines.en: The coin never changed.
Only how much of *yourself* you put on it.
lines.zh: 變的，只有你把多少押了上去。

lines.en: Follow, and send this to the friend who says,
lines.zh: 追蹤我，然後把這支傳給那個總說

lines.en: “but the expected value is *positive*,”
right before going *all in*.
lines.zh: 然後就直接全押的朋友。
